status: revised - supersedes prior scope on scheduling and build sequencing

platform.type: Responsive web app, installable as PWA

login.model: One shared shop login for v1
login.known_limitation: Shop password does not identify who performed a specific action (complete, flag, photo attach). Per-person accounts deferred to later.

crew_identity.mechanism: After choosing Crew mode, user selects their name from the company's people list. Session-level selection, not a login. Persists until 'I'm someone else' is tapped.
crew_identity.visibility_rule: A person only sees jobs they are assigned to.

scheduling_scope.decision: Lightweight - assigned-to field plus two crew actions, not a live status board
scheduling_scope.reasoning: Client voiced wanting to know when something's wrong without calling, not full live job tracking. A full status board (multiple in-progress states, thumb-tap forward/back controls, PWA offline state-sync) would compete directly with incumbent field-service platforms before the compliance wedge is validated. Scaling up from lightweight later is easier than descoping a full board after it ships.
office_actions: View complete/flagged state across all jobs

compliance_forms_scope.decision: In first build, alongside scheduling - not sequenced as a later increment
compliance_forms_scope.reasoning: Compliance automation is the core differentiator. Sequencing it after scheduling risked shipping a small, undifferentiated dispatch tool if the first increment ran long.
compliance_forms_scope.trigger: Only job types flagged as requiring regulatory documentation (v1: Alabama OSS install/repair)
compliance_forms_scope.output: Office prints or downloads PDF for wet signature
explicit_exclusions: No submission to ADPH or any authority

job_types_v1: Original ten ids in job-types.json. All schedule. CEP-5 only for oss_install_new and oss_repair. Plumbing and construction verticals are v2. Yard/pickup is a site, not a type.
non_goals_v1: Live status board / real-time job tracking
Filing regulatory forms on behalf of the user
Required layout sketch in first form slice
Job record spanning multiple calendar days
must_first_build: Jobs: type, date, optional time, assignees, complete/flag state
OSS-specific job fields (permit #, tank, system type)
Office view: all jobs, today/week, assignees, complete/flagged state
Crew view: assigned jobs only, mark complete, flag an issue
Compliance form draft: prefill, photos/notes, PDF export
later_after_v1: Live status states (en_route, on_site) - only if office demand confirmed post-launch
Per-person logins and action audit trail
locked_defaults: Office vs Crew chosen once per session after login
Office prints CEP-5; crew does not
Flag is a single free-text note with no categories
